services.desc: Lazy Day Rafts is excited to partner with Toonie Tours to bring you our new GUIDED Bike and Raft Adventure! Get ready to explore the best of Calgary's beauty in one unforgettable day? Lazy Day Raft Rentals and Toonie Tours have teamed up to deliver a one-of-a-kind Bike & Raft Tour that blends city sights, fresh air, and hassle-free adventure. Duration Depending on river flow, the adventure will take 5-6 hours Route 1. services.name: Pre-float Shuttle
services.desc: Pre-Float Shuttle All ages (and dogs) welcome! Please note: the pre-float shuttle is designed to be used at the BEGINNING of your float, NOT afterwards. Please see 'Reverse Shuttles' below. How It Works Step 1: Arrive 15 minutes prior to your float and park your vehicle at the downtown Lazy Day shop at 720 3 St NW of the Calgary Curling Club. Step 2: Come inside the shop (via the east door) and pick up a free parking pass. Step 3: Head outside to the shaded area near the front of the curling club to board the shuttle. Duration 30 minutes Note Please note that there is a short 5-minute walk from the shuttle drop-off location to the launch point at the river. The terrain has a slight slope

services.name: E-bike Tours
services.desc: After the success of last year’s inaugural e-bike “Nature tour” offerings, we have added two new tours: The Instagram Tour (3 hours) Get your selfie on at some of Calgary’s most iconic sights such as the Peace Bridge, the Saddledome, and Scotsman’s Hill. The Ride ‘n’ Raft (RnR) Tour (2 hours e-bike and lunch plus 3 hours rafting) The best of both worlds! Ride from the centre of Calgary to the edge of town on a leisurely bike ride along the magnificent Bow River without ever touching a city street. Along the way, your guide will share information about the diverse geography that you’ll pass through as you head west. Once you arrive at West Baker Park, enjoy a picnic lunch while you float
